admission.justification: Live host enumeration and current launch-record joining jointly prevent a stale receipt from becoming a selectable live recipient, with paging and incomplete-state tests.

applicability: The host-wide tray recipient inventory of existing unarchived AR seats and taskless sessions.
conditions: One bounded host live-agent walk is joined to bounded current launch-record paths; historical receipts alone cannot create a live row.
The API pages 50 seat rows with nextOffset, completeness and detail; taskful rows name role, task and whole agent ID.
Unreadable or incomplete scans keep known rows and report incompleteness; unavailable host state is explicit rather than an empty complete inventory.
Opening the tray or its target menu requests current seats again; distinct agents with the same role/task remain distinguishable.
exclusions: Absence from an incomplete page proves no terminal agent state.
This menu confers no lifecycle authority and starts no roles.
